title: Abigail Rides Out with Bread
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A rich man named Nabal was mean,
He would not share his bread.
So David's face grew hot and red,
"We'll fight him then!" he said.

[Chorus]
A gentle word can stop a fight,
So use kind words each day.
Heavenly Father loves the ones
Who bring peace, come what may.

[Verse 2]
But Abigail was wise and kind,
She packed up food to share.
She said, "Don't do what you'll regret,"
And David stopped right there.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, my peacemaker,
Your kind words did their part.
Heavenly Father's near tonight,
So rest your gentle heart.

[Chorus]
mood: Riding music. A gentle, rolling sway moves under the voice like a donkey's easy gait carrying Abigail down the hill, calm even while tempers run hot, so the calm itself becomes the lesson. The chorus broadens and warms, like a table being set for peace. By the last verse the rolling eases to a slow, low cradle, softer with each line, until it rests.
